item.observed: Pause during loading leaves the counter at 0:00 while scene readiness starts the beat.

item.observed: Stage-view camera auto-rotates even when preview-pause-btn is paused.
item.title: Dancers cannot hold a stable stage-view frame to study a cue — the 3D orbit continues rotating while the timeline is paused

item.observed: Paused fallback frames continue changing drop flash and camera shake.

item.observed: GET /api/clips returns at most 24 rows; older clips have no next page.
item.title: Crews lose older posts from the video wall once more than 24 are posted — the list is capped without pagination

item.observed: A failed GET /api/clips displays 'No clips yet' instead of an error.
item.title: Crews see a falsely empty video wall during network or server failures — the fetch catch converts every error into an empty list

item.observed: GET /api/clips/{id}/video always returns 200 and ignores Range requests.
item.title: Viewers cannot reliably play or seek wall clips in range-dependent mobile browsers — the video endpoint ignores byte ranges and always returns the whole object

item.observed: A non-video body labeled video/webm is accepted and published as a clip.
item.title: Wall viewers can get unplayable clips — the anonymous upload route trusts the supplied content type without validating video bytes

item.observed: The entire upload is read into memory before the 25 MiB limit is checked.
item.title: Visitors can lose access to the app during oversized anonymous uploads — the server allocates the whole body before enforcing its video size limit

item.observed: A video loading error leaves a black video element without a fallback label.
item.title: Wall viewers cannot identify broken clips when storage fails — the video element has no error fallback

item.observed: Wall tiles display crew, kit and song but omit the stored posting time.
item.title: Crews cannot tell when wall clips were posted — the tile never renders the returned created_at

item.observed: Playing a second wall video does not pause the first video.
item.title: Wall viewers hear overlapping clips — each video plays independently with no single-player coordination

item.observed: Space does not toggle pause unless the pause button itself has focus.
item.title: Keyboard users cannot pause the preview with Space from the stage — the preview key handler handles only Escape

item.observed: Clip lookups need an index on (id, is_deleted); only (is_deleted, created_at) exists.
item.title: The crew wall slows as posts accumulate — every video metadata request scans clips by unindexed id and deletion flag

item.observed: If the model omits removed_item_ids and retains item 6 in its cart, 6 is not banned.

item.observed: A tight budget still swaps the selected drop firework to another catalog item.

item.observed: An expensive non-drop cue can remain bigger than the chosen drop cue.
item.title: Dancers still receive their largest firework away from the beat drop — the changed planner keeps a cheaper existing drop cue without comparing other cues

item.observed: max-w-full can narrow a fixed-height 9:16 phone frame on a tall narrow screen.

item.observed: A drop at 14 seconds leaves DROP visible when the preview reaches 15 seconds.

item.observed: Tab can reach the underlying page while the fullscreen preview is open.

item.observed: A build or edit can replace cues without resetting the preview director's fired set.

item.observed: A MediaRecorder setup failure releases controls but leaves paint() scheduled.
item.title: Dancers who cannot record can leave a compositor running — the changed recording failure handler does not cancel its animation loop or stop its stream

item.observed: A recorder error can still download data and show 'Clip saved' on stop.

item.observed: A budget edit returning added_item_ids=[6] clears 6 from removed and permits it in the cart.

item.observed: A clip recorded for kit A can be uploaded with kit B's id after a background build.

item.observed: If inserting the clip row fails after object upload, the stored video is not removed.

item.observed: Retrying after a lost POST response creates a second clip with a new id.

item.observed: The clip row does not store video.filename.

item.observed: An older GET /api/clips can finish last and replace the freshly posted wall state.
item.title: Crews can see their newly posted clip disappear until reload — overlapping wall fetches apply responses without checking request order

item.observed: The wall and API provide no delete or unpublish action for a posted clip.
item.title: Crews cannot remove an accidentally posted video from the public wall — neither the wall nor the clip API offers deletion

item.observed: For 5 dancers at $17, the fallback can keep only 4 wands although five can fit.
item.title: Dancers still get too few group wands in a budgeted fallback kit — the changed fitter trims crew wands before replacing costlier cues

item.observed: An old pending order can set the confirmation in a newly opened checkout.

item.observed: A named song absent from the trends list becomes 'Your trending track' on fallback.

item.observed: A cue can display model effect text inconsistent with its catalog item.

item.observed: A Khmer fallback kit still contains English catalog effect and item names.

item.observed: A fallback request saying 'no confetti' still selects the confetti item.

item.observed: An invalid changes value can leave inserted revisions even when applied is false.

item.observed: Build remains enabled while a follow-up recording is transcribing.
